thread:
jessica_cs: Quick sync — Polaris reserved pool goes live tomorrow 11:00 PT. Need one final pass on quotas, autoscale policy, and who's owning the loadtest. Can folks confirm ownership + any blockers?

oliver_se: I can own the loadtest run and analysis. Planning to run a 2hr mixed-profile with 50% chat gen / 50% embeddings. Will need the exact quota numbers to shape traffic.

mike_sre: Re: autoscale — we need the expected RPS and the SLO targets. Are we keeping the default burst window? If so I want to validate scaling cooldowns.

jessica_cs: target steady qps ~900, burst up to 2.2k during warm minutes. SLO = 99th pct latency < 350ms for standard route. We'll default to burst window = 5m unless objections.

nina_security: FYI Polaris requested customer-managed KMS and VPC peering. Networking team said peering is in place but we'll need to verify route tables and egress rules before full traffic. Can someone loop infra?

tera_enable: I can handle customer enablement comms and runbook handoff. Sending the short checklist to Polaris tonight. Also will run demo with their SREs at 9am PT.

mike_sre: Ok for autoscale policy I'll propose these knobs: 
```
{"min_replicas":3, "max_replicas":18, "scale_up_threshold_rps":1200, "scale_down_threshold_rps":700, "cooldown_secs":180}
```
Will run through a dry-run in staging at 08:30 PT.

oliver_se: Loadtest plan (quick): 10m ramp, 90m steady @900qps mix, 20m spike to 2k qps, 20m cool-down. Script uses our rally harness: 
```
./rally run --profile polaris-mix --duration 120m --out polaris-run-$(date +%s).json
```
I'll push the script to the shared bucket and tag team.

deploy-bot: CI check: reserved-pool-config PR #421 passed unit tests and infra lint — readiness: green. Deployment window: 11:00-11:15 PT tomorrow.

jessica_cs: blockers? we need final quota numbers from finance (billing commit) + confirmation that reserve has been warmed (cache priming). Also confirm fallback model list if primary hits OOM.

nina_security: KMS keys synced, audit logs enabled. Need confirmation from billing on quota assignment. Security won't block.

mike_sre: I'll validate cooldowns and memory headroom. If we see persistent OOM risk on the primary model I'll auto-route to the quantized variant as fallback. Need model variant IDs from model-ops.

oliver_se: I'll include KV-cache priming in the loadtest pre-step (10m prerun of representative prompts) and capture token-level latency.

tera_enable: I'll send the customer-facing timeline + escalation list after 6pm PT. Also prepping the rollback script and runbook snippets.

jessica_cs: Perfect. Ownership recap: loadtest/analysis = oliver_se; autoscale + infra validation = mike_sre; enablement + customer comms = tera_enable; security check = nina_security; config PR merged = deploy-bot noted. Billing/quota owner? @maria_fin?

maria_fin: (added) Confirming: quota assignment approved, billing anchor in place. Final quota = 1.2M tokens/day reserved (maps to the QPS profile).

jessica_cs: Awesome — last ask: post-results, please drop a 1-paragraph summary with any post-mortem items and whether we hit 99th pct latency SLO. We'll do a quick retro Friday. :thumbsup:
